Vendored header-only libraries for the CSignalsmithStretch target.

signalsmith-stretch/  (MIT, LICENSE.txt alongside)
  https://github.com/Signalsmith-Audio/signalsmith-stretch
  commit 57b93f4e9206a089a45387eaa39bdc9f310d3308 (main, 2026-01-24), header version 1.3.2
  (SignalsmithStretch::version). The last git tag, 1.1.0 (2025-01-29), predates the move to the
  signalsmith-linear backend and has no Accelerate FFT path, so main is pinned by commit instead.
  Only signalsmith-stretch.h is vendored (cmd/ and web/ are tools and demos).

signalsmith-linear/  (MIT, LICENSE.txt alongside)
  https://github.com/Signalsmith-Audio/linear
  tag 0.3.1, commit 5668673560146a9cfe38c25315071e3fd68c8317 — the version signalsmith-stretch's
  CMakeLists.txt pins via FetchContent. Only what the stretch header needs is vendored:
  fft.h, stft.h and platform/fft-accelerate.h (used when SIGNALSMITH_USE_ACCELERATE is defined,
  which Package.swift sets; ACCELERATE_NEW_LAPACK is set too, matching the library's CMake).
  linear.h and the other platform backends are not used by the stretch header.

Do not enable -ffast-math for this target: fft.h #errors on Apple Clang 16.0.0 because that
compiler miscompiles the SIMD code, and SwiftPM never sets it anyway.
